title: Neural network on cortical thickness identifies cognitive impairment in WTC responders
summary: An artificial neural network trained on 34 regional cortical thickness measures from MRI in 119 World Trade Center responders (57 with cognitive impairment, 62 intact) reached AUC 0.96 (95% CI 0.91-1.00) in the discovery sample, with 96.0% accuracy. In a separate replication sample the AUC was 0.90 (95% CI 0.70-1.00) with 90.0% accuracy, sensitivity and specificity. The sample is small and the abstract does not describe the replication sample size.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network on regional cortical thickness from Freesurfer MRI measures

evidence.tested: Model development in a discovery sample and evaluation in a replication sample.
evidence.unknown: Replication sample size; generalization beyond this responder cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An artificial neural network discriminated cognitive impairment from cortical thickness data.
